_comment: Mutation testing on src/core only (ADR-0008). Coverage proves a line ran; it says nothing about whether an assertion would have noticed it being wrong, and for a bijection with no database that gap is the entire risk.
_comment_timeout: Some mutants make a sampling loop run forever (turning `if (candidate < limit) return candidate` into `if (false)` is one). A timeout counts as killed, which is right — a test that never finishes has noticed. The budget is ~3x the real suite time so a merely slow mutant is not failed for being slow.
